newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: V&N Waermetechnik sees higher 97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: V&N Waermetechnik sees higher 97 earnings.

text.p: Austrian heating equipment maker Vogel & Noot Waermetechnik AG said on Wednesday it expected to post higher group sales and earnings in 1997.

Board member Rudolf Jurak told journalists he expects the company to post a pretax profit of around 130 million schillings after 120.5 million in 1996, while sales are seen climbing to 1.95 billion from 1.84 billion in 1996.

Depreciation would come in around 20 million schillings higher than that last year, while cash flow is forecast at 270 million this year after 251 million in 1996, Jurak said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
